summary: Electra Battery Materials Corp filed a Form 6-K on July 20, 2026, announcing an amendment to its senior secured credit facility. The amendment increases capacity to incur permitted indebtedness and grants greater flexibility for liens and payments related to government financing arrangements, on a pari passu basis with existing lenders. No specific financial terms, stake, price, or premium were disclosed. This is a routine credit agreement modification, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisors, or structural changes were mentioned. The filing is a foreign private issuer report incorporated by reference into prior registration statements.
